Hi Natalie —

Great to connect yesterday. Per our conversation I attached a first-pass Mutual Action Plan (MAP) and a short evaluation plan so we can align on timelines and who needs to be present for executive briefings. Key asks in this note:

- Confirm your executive sponsor(s) for the program (we propose Dr. Maya Singh as the clinical sponsor and Paul Reed as the CIO sponsor).
- Agree a single-week evaluation window and one EB (executive briefing) slot during that window for a leadership sign-off meeting.
- Confirm procurement/legal contacts and any required evidence for security/compliance.

Proposed MAP highlights (see redwood_map_draft_v0.1.xlsx):
- Week 0 (prep): NDA / data access agreements, environment setup
- Week 1: sandbox evaluation + test prompts / acceptance criteria run
- Week 2: performance / latency / cost validation + integration smoke tests
- Week 3: executive briefing and go/no-go decision

EB scheduling options (please pick one):
- Option A: Tue June 29, 10:00–11:00 PT
- Option B: Thu July 1, 14:00–15:00 PT

I'll follow up with a calendar invite once you confirm the sponsor roster and preferred EB slot. I've cc'd Laura and Rishi who will own onboarding and commercial checklists on our side.

Thanks,
Connor O'Brien
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
